title: Oli and the Sock Robot
blurb: Oli builds a robot from a sock and two spoons. It does not do what Oli expects.

chapters.title: A Robot Made of Socks
chapters.text:
Oli lives in a small house in Scotland. It is a rainy day, and Oli is bored. He cannot go outside to play.

"I will build a robot," says Oli. He finds a stripy sock, two silver spoons and a cardboard box. He sticks two buttons on the sock for eyes. He puts the spoons on the side for arms.

"Your name is Sockbot," says Oli. He gives Sockbot a big smile with a pen. Then Oli puts the toy on the table and goes to get a snack.

chapters.title: Sockbot Wakes Up
chapters.text:
When Oli comes back, the table is empty! Sockbot is gone. Then Oli hears a clink, clink, clink from the kitchen.

Oli runs in. Sockbot is on the floor, and the biscuit tin is open. Biscuits are everywhere! "Sockbot, stop!" cries Oli.

But Sockbot does not stop. It waves its spoons and bangs the pots. Bang! Crash! The cat jumps on a chair and hides under a cushion.

Oli laughs so much that his tummy hurts. How can a sock be so noisy? Then he sees something. A tiny mouse is sitting inside the sock.

chapters.title: The Mouse Has a Plan
chapters.text:
Oli picks up the sock very gently. The mouse peeps out. It has big black eyes and a twitchy nose. "Squeak," says the mouse. It looks hungry.

"You wanted a biscuit," says Oli. "You did not need to wear my sock!" He gives the mouse a tiny crumb. The mouse nibbles it happily.

Oli's mum comes in. She looks at the biscuits on the floor. She looks at the mouse. She looks at Oli. "Please clean this up," she says with a smile.

Oli puts the mouse in a box with soft cloth. In the evening, he carries it to the garden. "Goodbye, Sockbot," he says. The little mouse runs off. Oli has the best rainy day ever.
